basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old Filipino-American based in San Francisco, currently working as a software engineer. I have a deep love for my cultural roots and often seek out content that connects me back to the Philippines. I'm a huge fan of podcasts, especially those that cover everyday life and entertainment. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work while unwinding. I'm single and enjoy exploring new hobbies like gaming and cooking traditional Filipino dishes.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science from a well-known university in California. My knowledge is rooted in technology, but I also have a keen interest in Filipino culture and media, which I've explored through self-teaching and community engagement. I regularly listen to podcasts and watch content related to Filipino-American experiences.
